Running shake --fix has revealed that #adaptation_note isn't available automatically when importing a typical mathlib file (in particular, MathlibTest/rewrites.lean broke after some imports were shaken).

I could add import Mathlib.Tactic.AdaptationNote to the test file and call it a day, but I wonder if we should put a public import somewhere further up in the import chain?

btw MathlibTest/BasicFiles/ contains tests that verify such basic commands are available, so if you're adding #adaptation_note to Mathlib.Init you can also add a simple check for it in MathlibTest/BasicFiles/Init.lean, it tries to guard against shake mishaps

Oh noes, it is increasing technical debt! /jk

:peace_sign:

Thanks for the delegation! I would like someone to check that this change from import to public import (suggested by an error message) makes sense though: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/39096/changes#r3211261695
